messages:
maria: Quick proposal: run a probe-driven per-tenant canary + tiny A/B slice. Goal: validate quality & cache behavior per-customer while keeping global latency budget safe.

maria: Plan outline: 1) cohorts: internal (0.1% of traffic), partners (0.5%), public AB (0.5% control vs treatment). 2) run synthetic probes for each tenant cohort (fast path, long prompt, multi-turn). 3) enforce per-tenant incremental qps caps and a global extra-qps ceiling. 4) fallback chain + fast kill-switch.

ash: 👍 sounds pragmatic. define "probe" and "per-tenant cap" please.

maria: Probe = a deterministic request set run every 60s from multiple regions (us, eu, apac). Probes assert correctness (intent match), length/format, and perf (p95/p99). Per-tenant cap = max additional qps allowed beyond baseline for that tenant (e.g., baseline*0.05 or hard cap of +5 qps). If cap exceeded, hold new requests for that tenant in queue and serve from v1 or low-latency variant.

kevin: For probes include: short chat, long-context (~2k tokens), and a heavy KV-cache-warm sequence. Compare token output distributions and KV hit rate to baseline. Also run a fuzz input once/hr to catch regressions.

elyse: Failure gating? what trips a throttle vs full rollback?

maria: Gate rules: APPLIED IN ORDER - if any applies for 2 consecutive probe windows (2m): 1) probe failure rate > 5% absolute over baseline -> pause exposure for that tenant cohort 2) p99 latency increase > 30% for that tenant cohort -> reduce batch size & enable token-cap 3) error-rate (5xx) delta > +0.4% -> immediate rollback to v1 for that tenant 4) global extra-qps > ceiling for 3m -> circuit-break to shadow-only.

ash: Fallback specifics? prefer to keep responses but degrade gracefully.

maria: Fallback order: 1) reduce model batch_size and max_new_tokens 2) switch to quantized low-latency variant for that tenant 3) route to v1 golden model 4) final: respond with short canned message + incident tag if nothing else available.

kevin: Instrumentation checklist: synthetic_probe_success_rate (per-tenant, per-region), tenant_p95/p99_latency, tenant_kv_hit_ratio, tenant_error_rate, tenant_extra_qps, global_extra_qps_consumed. Dashboards per-tenant with heatmap.

maria: Kill-switch: auto-disable cohort exposure if any tenant fails rule 3 twice in 24h OR if global_extra_qps_consumed > 120% for 5 consecutive minutes. Manual override via console with audit log.

elyse: Enterprise asks: can enterprises opt out entirely? yes -> flag supports tenant_holdout list and "opt_out_until" timestamp per-tenant. Also offer "preview mode" for selected tenants (shadow + manual accept).

maria: Rollout windows: per-region windows (2h) staggered to avoid overlap. Suggested: EU 08:00-10:00 local, US 14:00-16:00 local, APAC 02:00-04:00 local. Allow "quiet-hours" where cohorts are not expanded.

maria: Quick sample flag config to give FF team (pseudo-json):

```json
{
  "flag": "tenant_probe_canary_v3",
  "cohorts": [
    {"name":"internal","pct":0.1},
    {"name":"partners","pct":0.5},
    {"name":"public_ab","pct":0.5, "ab_control": 0.5}
  ],
  "per_tenant_caps": {"type":"proportional","max_pct":5, "hard_cap_qps":5},
  "probes": {"interval_s":60, "regions":["us","eu","apac"], "tests":["short","long","kv_warm"]},
  "fallback_order": ["reduce_batch","v2_quant","v1"],
  "kill_switch": {"global_consumption_pct":120, "duration_m":5, "tenant_failures":2},
  "holdouts": {"tenants":[], "preview_mode":[]},
  "windows": {"eu":"local:08:00/2h","us":"local:14:00/2h","apac":"local:02:00/2h"}
}
```

kevin: Nice. Small ask: add a synthetic smoke-run that fires after deploy and tags the deployment id in tracing. We'll need that to correlate.

maria: Good call. We'll emit "probe_smoke_deploy_id" tag.

ops-bot: deployment scheduled: canary-tenant-probes -> job#5088 @ 2024-06-07T14:00Z. :rocket:

elyse: Launch checklist (condensed): 1) probes instrumented & dashboards 2) FF supports per-tenant caps & holdouts 3) fallback variants pre-warmed 4) runbook + pager + playbook 5) synthetic smoke on deploy 6) enterprise opt-outs tested

maria: I'll create the rollout PR, add runbook link, and ping security for tenant data handling review. timeline: start probes next week, open AB after 48h of stable probes. Comments?

ash: none. thanks.

kevin: I'll add the dashboards and a 5m smoke test for each cohort.

elyse: please add me to runbook review and tag me in the PR.

maria: will do. thanks all!
